title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Global Dengue
summary: Dengue is a year-round risk in many parts of the world, with outbreaks commonly occurring every 2–5 years. Travelers to risk areas should prevent mosquito bites. Country List : Colombia, Vietnam, Maldives, Bolivia, Cambodia, Kenya, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Costa Rica, Marshall Islands, Vanua

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Kenya
summary: The Kenyan Ministry of Health has confirmed an imported case, as well as other linked cases, of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in Nairobi, Kenya.

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Ghana
summary: There is an outbreak of yellow fever in the Upper West Region of Ghana. Travelers to the Upper West Region should take steps to prevent yellow fever by getting vaccinated at least 10 days before travel and taking steps to prevent mosquito bites.

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Colombia
summary: An increased number of cases of yellow fever have been reported in Colombia.
